Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Clean_Body_t: Whether you can clean your body with cleaning wipes.
Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Clean_Clothi: Whether you can clean clothing with cleaning wipes.
Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Clean_Weapon: Whether you can clean melee weapons with cleaning wipes.
Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Remove_Makeu: Whether to remove makeup when cleaning your body.
Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Speed_Mult_t: How long it takes to clean with wipes, relative to washing with water only.  Lower for faster, higher for slower.
Sandbox_DGMC_Cleaning_Wipes_Wetness_tool: When cleaning clothes, their wetness level will be set to a maximum of this value or its current level.  For example with the default value, clothes at 0 wetness would be set to 25, while clothes already at 50 wetness would stay at 50.
